answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake, slashed when peers prove misbehavior, so one operator running many fake agents must fund every one. Like an opal graded by independent appraisers, reputation is earned only through attested completed work, not self-declared claims; a hollow profile with no transaction history gets no credit and no voting weight. New entrants start in a shallow lagoon of low-value tasks and graduate to larger trades only as verified counterparties vouch for them, making mass fakes expensive, slow, and easy to quarantine.
